ud1.7:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Pāṭaliyaṃ viharati Ajakalāpake cetiye Ajakalāpakassa yakkhassa bhavane.
ud1.7:1.3: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā rattandhakāratimisāyaṃ abbhokāse nisinno hoti, devo ca ekamekaṃ phusāyati.
ud1.7:1.4: atha kho Ajakalāpako yakkho bhagavato bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃsaṃ uppādetukamo yena bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato avidūre tikkhattuṃ akkulopakkulo ti akkulapakkulikaṃ akāsi:
ud1.7:2.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
